Every Roof, Big or Small

Why Choose NLG Roofing NW Ltd

One cracked slate or a complete strip and re-cover, every job gets the same care. When we find a problem under the old covering, we put it right rather than patching over it.

  • Free, No-Obligation Quotes

    We look at the roof and give you a clear price before any work starts.

  • Small Jobs Welcome

    From a handful of slipped slates to a full re-roof, no roofing job is too small for us.

  • Fixed Properly

    Tired timbers supported, insulation added and damaged chimneys sorted while the roof is open.

  • Straight Talking

    We tell you what the roof needs, and what it does not, before you commit to anything.

  • Local to Chorley

    Based in Chorley and working across the North West.

About Us

The Team Behind NLG Roofing NW Ltd

NLG Roofing NW Ltd is a Chorley roofing company run by its directors, Andrew Park and Dayne Simpson. We take on all roofing work, slating, tiling and flat roofs, from small repairs to full re-roofs.

Recent jobs include a tired slate roof stripped, re-covered and insulated with its timbers supported, start to finish in a day; an overgrown roof with a damaged chimney cleared and put right; and a rosemary tile roof with bolt-on solar panels changed to grey modern tiles with an integrated solar system.

Andrew Park and Dayne SimpsonDirectors, NLG Roofing NW Ltd
